changelog: New full Edit Vehicle page, like D2C's Edit a Vehicle screen — click the pencil icon on any car row to open it. Covers Status (category, condition, posted), General Info (VIN, Stock #, Make, Model, Year, Trim), Vehicle Info (odometer, price, original price, passengers, transmission, drivetrain, colors, doors, fuel type, engine, cylinders), and Features (comma-separated tags, auto-filled from D2C scans when available). Saves back into the same car record used everywhere else in the app — Inventory table, Dashboard, Facebook posting all reflect the changes immediately.
